descriptions.preferred: This medium-sized tree has unusual foliage. The leaves emerge as a pale yellowish green, turning to a light, bright green as they mature. They do not form a flat plane as most forms do, but the lobes bend up or down slightly, or some lobes twist slightly. Some leaves hang down, some flat, some on edge, creating a foliage cover toothing between the notches. This shorter type of tree tends to grow rather broad and not strongly upright, reaching 3-4 m high. The total foliage appearance is rather feathery. Another name by which this cultivar has been known is

rhs.description: Small, broad, bushy tree, slow-growing to about 3m tall with slightly pendulous branches and feathery, leaves that hang, lay flat or twist - appearing slightly 'wind blown'. Leaves open yellow-green in spring, maturing to bright green, then turning orange and yellow in autumn. Inconspicuous hanging clusters of small, red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Acer leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. Suitable for bonsai cultivation . See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜种植于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，也可耐全日照。槭树叶焦边通常由土壤缺水或暴露过强所致。适合容器栽培，但在生长季干旱时段需特别注意浇水。也适合制作盆景。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、宽展、丛生状小乔木，生长缓慢，高约 3 米，枝条略下垂。 叶片轻盈细致，可下垂、平展或轻微扭曲，整体呈现些许“被风吹拂”的效果。 春季展叶为黄绿色，后转为鲜绿色，秋季变为橙色和黄色。 春季开不显眼的小型红紫色花，成下垂簇状，随后可能结带翅的紫色翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一中等大小的乔木具有不同寻常的叶姿。 叶片初展时为淡黄绿色，成熟后转为浅亮绿色。 与多数品种叶片形成较平展叶面的状态不同，本品种的裂片会略向上或向下弯曲，有些还会轻微扭转。 有的叶片下垂，有的平展，有的侧立，从而形成层次丰富的叶幕效果。 叶缘在裂刻之间具锯齿。 该品种树形较矮，通常横向开展较宽，直立性不强，高约 3-4 米。 整体叶幕外观较为轻盈、羽毛状。 该品种也曾以 ‘Machiyou’ 为名流通，并曾被误作 ‘Myoi’ 出售。
